label: PF Backlog 468
title: RCCA: grooming dedup marking wrote across projects/items (bounded same-project + self-only + threshold)
body:
Source: found during BI-PF-0432 implementation (2026-10-07), self-detected before push.

DEFECT: the first `grooming._mark_duplicates` wrote `links.possible_duplicate_of` to EVERY non-canonical member
of the candidate GROUP, including candidates in OTHER projects (find_similar scans scope-wide). A grooming run
therefore modified a REAL product's backlog (`products/ProductForge-Dashboard/backlog/items/BI-0006.json`) - out
of the groomed item's boundary. Also, the candidate's id/scope/project were dropped by `_gather_context`, so the
marking could not resolve cross-scope candidates correctly. And a missing threshold marked any score>0 candidate.

RCCA (5-Why):
1. A real product backlog item was modified by grooming. 2. `_mark_duplicates` wrote links to candidate items
(not just the groomed item) and did not filter by project. 3. find_similar scans scope-wide and returns every
score>0. 4. The marking code assumed same-project candidates and no threshold. 5. Guard: the marking must be
BOUNDED to the groomed item's own (scope, project) and must write ONLY to the groomed item; apply a similarity
threshold. (Implemented: same-project-only candidates + mark self only + threshold; test
`test_cross_project_candidates_are_never_marked` + `test_low_score_is_not_marked`.) Stray writes reverted.

dashboard_impact: no UI surface.
